connector.name: Earth
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Mireye Earth - federal-source-cited geospatial data for any MCP-aware agent.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.mireye.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package mireye-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.mireye, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MIREYE_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Mireye API. Defaults to https://api.mireye.com. Stored login credentials only attach when created against this same URL.

env.name: MIREYE_BEARER_TOKEN
env.description: Mireye API bearer token. Optional alternative to `mireye-mcp login` for non-interactive hosts.

env.name: MIREYE_TIMEOUT_S
env.description: Per-request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 120 (must exceed the ~110s /v1/ask server deadline).

env.name: MIREYE_MCP_CREDENTIALS_FILE
env.description: Path to the credentials file written by `mireye-mcp login`. Defaults to ~/.config/mireye-mcp/credentials.json.
